caption:
French inflation falls more than expected as fuel prices drop

Prices still remain too high for the ECB, which is expected to raise its key interest rates again. Consumer prices in the eurozone's second-largest economy fell more than expected as fuel prices declined.

Reported by The Wall Street Journal.
